notes: Only the two step pages were provided; the inventory/Element ID pages were not included, so Element IDs (type ids) are best guesses from piece shapes and may be inaccurate.
Piece identification and exact stud placements are approximated from the small step images; stacking relations are plausible but not stud-exact.
Studs and anti-studs are modelled as numbered regions (top.1, top.2, bottom.1 ...) rather than every individual stud, so that each port is used by only one join.
The grille is attached to the front 2x2 brick via a clip/bar side port (b12 clip, b11 bar), an assumption from the image.
Wheel rim to tire is modelled as ball (rim) into socket (tire) so the pair is a compatible join; physically the tire stretches over the rim.

Step 10 inset: yellow plate placed on a transparent 2x2 plate, treated as b20/b21. Step 11 adds the yellow top plate with two red round 1x1 plates. Step 8 shows the underside with two dark-gray 2x2 plates with axle holes and two axles; four wheels (yellow rim + black tire) added in step 12 via repeat.
